name: Alameda Meals on Wheels
description: Alameda Meals on Wheels is a locally funded nonprofit that delivers a hot midday meal every day to homebound Alameda residents of all ages, including people recovering from surgery or hospitalization and those who can't shop or cook for themselves.
fullDescription: Alameda Meals on Wheels is a locally funded nonprofit that delivers a hot midday meal every day to homebound Alameda residents of all ages, including people recovering from surgery or hospitalization and those who can't shop or cook for themselves.
whatTheyOffer:
- Hot midday meal delivered 7 days a week, including holidays
- Serves City of Alameda residents of all ages who need help
- Sliding fee scale based on ability to pay
- Daily personal contact from volunteer drivers
- Alameda Friendly Visitors program for weekly companionship visits
howToGetIt: Call 510-865-6131 during office hours (9 a.m.-12 noon weekdays) to ask about starting meal delivery. Service is for Alameda residents who are homebound or unable to shop or cook, such as after surgery or hospitalization.
keywords: Alameda Meals on Wheels, home delivered meals, senior meals, homebound, disabled, hot lunch, meal delivery, Friendly Visitors, surgery recovery
